notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting5': No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Tatooine: Mos Espa, Neimoidian Advisor (starting Interrupt) and Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (the Effect it deploys); these count toward the 60.

The list as posted totals 61 cards: the Characters header says 23 but 22 are listed (2 Darth Maul With Lightsaber, Lord Maul, Darth Maul, 3 Watto, P-60, P-59, 8 Destroyer Droid, 2 Aurra Sing, OWO-1 With Backup, SSA-1015, Sebulba). Counts are kept as published.

The title and strategy mark this as an Episode I deck and every card is from the Episode I sets (Tatooine, Coruscant, Reflections III, Theed Palace), so posted 'Control' dested Control (Dark) (Coruscant) and 'Alter' dested Alter (Dark) (Coruscant).

Posted 'Tatooine Watto's Junkyard', 'Tatooine Mos Espa', 'Tatooine Marketplace' and 'Naboo' dested the Dark sites/system; 'Mauls Double Bladed Lightsaber' dested Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber; 'His Name Is Anankin' dested His Name Is Anakin; 'The Phantom Menance' dested The Phantom Menace (2 posted though the card is unique).
